content:
白婉茹娇躯颤抖起来，轻咬红唇，却始终没有说什么，似乎在默许着他的动作。看似扭捏，实则半推半就。突然，外面传来一道清脆年轻的女声：“妈，我回来了！”“不好，是灵儿，她放假从省城回来了！”白婉茹瞬间清醒，连忙从陈青云身上爬了起来。现在两人这幅样子，若是被唐灵儿发现，那她就没脸做人了！“快，去衣柜里躲一躲！”白婉茹立刻拉着陈青云，抓起刚脱下来的衣物，钻进了衣柜内。衣柜面积不大，两人只能紧紧贴在一起，严丝合缝，甚至能听到彼此的喘气声。“砰！”很快，卧室的门被推开，唐灵儿走了进来。隔着衣柜的门缝，陈青云偷偷望出去。只见她大概十七八的年纪，清纯动人，五官和白婉茹有几分相似，但又更加精致。她身材高挑，穿着白色t恤，酥匈虽然不及母亲那么饱满，但也足以傲视同龄人。腰肢盈盈一握，下面穿着齐臀小热裤，两条纤细修长的美腿，令人忍不住捧在手中把玩。哪怕她没有化妆，依旧美的惊人，可以想象学校里有多少男生为她疯狂！“妈不在家啊……”唐灵儿发现屋子里没人，正要出去，目光却突然落到床上的粉色玩具。“咦，这是什么？”她下意识拿起来，按下中间的按钮。“嗡嗡嗡！”突然，那玩具竟然高速震颤起来。唐灵儿瞬间睁大双眼，俏脸涨得通红。她毕竟成年了，也通过网络了解过这方面的事情，一下子就认了出来。但没想到，平日里那个严肃的妈妈，竟然私底下偷偷玩这种东西！“都怪你！以后灵儿会怎么看我？”衣柜内，白婉茹懊恼无比，回头瞪了陈青云一眼。“夫人，这可是你买的宝贝，怎么能怪我呢？”陈青云说着，不经意往前一顶。白婉茹下意识往后靠了靠，过了几秒才反应过来，立刻掐了一下他的胳膊。陈青云吃痛之下也不甘示弱，双手抓住她的饱满。“青云，不可以！我闺女就在外面，要是被发现就完了！”白婉茹紧张无比。“夫人，这样不是更有意思么？而且只要你不出声，她不会发现的！”陈青云双手抱住她的腰肢，更加大胆起来。“唔唔唔……”白婉茹只能捂住嘴，生怕叫出来，但同时，她又体会到一种难以言喻的刺激，浑身都在颤抖。

这时，唐灵儿也有了动作，竟然也拿起了那玩具……“啊！”很快，唐灵儿忍不住叫出了声，闭上双眼，紧咬红唇，仿佛在享受着什么。“灵儿这丫头，怎么学坏了？”见到这一幕，白婉茹又羞又恼，没想到女儿会做这种事，还被陈青云给看到了。“有其母，必有其女！”陈青云轻舔白婉茹的耳垂，目光却直勾勾盯着外面的唐灵儿，内心的火焰熊熊燃烧。他本来将唐灵儿当成小丫头，但现在看来，这朵花蕊已经成熟了，甚至在等待异性的采撷！十几分钟后。唐灵儿终于结束了，香汗淋漓，面若桃花，大口大口喘着气。她清理了一下屋子，这才蹑手蹑脚走出卧室。确定她离开，陈青云和白婉茹才从衣柜内出来。“青云，灵儿还没交过男朋友，平时也不是这样的……”白婉茹有些尴尬，想为女儿辩解。“我明白，像她这个年纪的女孩，好奇心重一点很正常！”陈青云说道。“那你快回去吧，千万别被灵儿发现！”白婉茹压低声音。“好。”陈青云点了点头，起身离开别墅。他没有直接回家，而是买了水果，打车前往县人民医院，去探望宁轻眉。病房内。宁轻眉躺在床上，正在看一本书，那绝美的侧脸无懈可击，高贵清冷，就像是月宫仙子，不是庸脂俗粉能比的。一时间，陈青云都有些看呆了，手中的水果都掉落在地，引起了她的注意。“你怎么来了？”宁轻眉看到他有些意外，美眸却闪过一抹欣喜。毕竟两人只是萍水相逢，无亲无故，而陈青云非但救了她，还特地来看望……“轻眉姐，看守水库是我的工作，你差点出了事，我当然要负责到底！”陈青云正色道。宁轻眉露出赞赏之色，点头道：“现在像你这样有担当的年轻干部，真是越来越少了！”“哎……我算哪门子干部啊，之前还得罪了人，被发配水库呢！”陈青云无奈摇头。“我倒是觉得，你马上就要交贵人了！”宁轻眉浅笑道。闻言，陈青云有些奇怪，因为之前萧云妃也说过类似的话，甚至还跟他打了赌。“对了！”突然，宁轻眉像是想到了什么，俏脸微微泛红，高贵清冷的气息消失，反而变得有些羞涩。“你之前说过，可以治疗白虎，是真的假的？”宁轻眉小声问道。“当然！这抓凤筋的手法，可是我陈家祖上传下来的。轻眉姐，你要是不相信，现在就可以试试！”陈青云说道。陈青云内心有些期待。毕竟，宁轻眉这样的大美人，就像是高岭之花，普通人连认识的资格都没有。若是能与她亲密接触，又怎能不高兴呢？　　请记住本书首发域名：fzhldax。顶点小说网手机版阅读网址：fzhldax

Bai Wanru's delicate body trembled and she bit her red lips, but she never said anything, as if she was acquiescing to his actions.It seems to be coercion, but in fact it is half push and half give.Suddenly, a clear young female voice came from outside: "Mom, I'm back!" "No, it's Ling'er, she's back from the provincial capital on vacation!" Bai Wanru suddenly woke up and quickly got up from Chen Qingyun.If Tang Ling'er discovered the two of them looking like this now, she would be shameless!"Quick, go hide in the closet!" Bai Wanru immediately pulled Chen Qingyun, grabbed the clothes she just took off, and got into the closet.The wardrobe is not large, so the two of them can only stick together so tightly that they can even hear each other's breathing."Bang!" Soon, the bedroom door was pushed open and Tang Linger walked in.Chen Qingyun peeked out through the crack in the closet door.I saw that she was about seventeen or eighteen years old, pure and charming, and her facial features were somewhat similar to Bai Wanru's, but more refined.She is tall and wearing a white T-shirt. Although she is not as plump as her mother, she is still enough to look down on her peers.Her waist is full, and she is wearing hip-length hot pants underneath. Her two slender legs are so beautiful that you can't help but hold them in your hands and play with them.Even if she doesn't wear makeup, she is still stunningly beautiful. You can imagine how many boys in school are crazy about her!"Mom's not at home..." Tang Ling'er found that no one was in the house and was about to go out when her eyes suddenly fell on the pink toy on the bed."Hey, what is this?" She picked it up subconsciously and pressed the button in the middle."Buzz buzz!" Suddenly, the toy vibrated at high speed.Tang Linger's eyes widened instantly, and her pretty face turned red.After all, she was an adult and had learned about this matter through the Internet, so she recognized it immediately.But I didn't expect that the usually serious mother would secretly play with this kind of thing!"It's all your fault! What will Ling'er think of me in the future?" In the closet, Bai Wanru was extremely annoyed and turned back to glare at Chen Qingyun."Madam, this is the treasure you bought, how can you blame me?" Chen Qingyun said, inadvertently moving forward.Bai Wanru leaned back subconsciously, and it took a few seconds to react before she immediately pinched his arm.Chen Qingyun was not willing to be outdone despite the pain, and grabbed her plump breasts with both hands."Qingyun, no! My daughter is outside. If she is discovered, it will be over!" Bai Wanru was extremely nervous."Madam, isn't this more interesting? And as long as you don't say anything, she won't find out!" Chen Qingyun hugged her waist with both hands and became bolder."Uh huh..." Bai Wanru could only cover her mouth for fear of screaming, but at the same time, she felt an indescribable stimulation and her whole body was trembling.

At this time, Tang Ling'er also made a move, and even picked up the toy... "Ah!" Soon, Tang Ling'er couldn't help shouting, closed her eyes, and bit her red lips, as if she was enjoying something."How could this girl, Ling'er, be so bad at learning?" Seeing this scene, Bai Wanru was ashamed and annoyed. She didn't expect that her daughter would do such a thing and be seen by Chen Qingyun."Like mother, like daughter!" Chen Qingyun licked Bai Wanru's earlobe, but stared straight at Tang Linger outside, the fire burning in his heart.He originally regarded Tang Ling'er as a little girl, but now it seems that this flower has matured and is even waiting for the opposite sex to pick it!Ten minutes later.Tang Ling'er finally finished, dripping with sweat, with a peach-shaped face, and gasping for air.She cleaned the house and then tiptoed out of the bedroom.After making sure she left, Chen Qingyun and Bai Wanru came out of the closet."Qingyun, Ling'er hasn't had a boyfriend yet, and she's not usually like this..." Bai Wanru was a little embarrassed and wanted to defend her daughter."I understand that it's normal for girls of her age to be a little more curious!" Chen Qingyun said."Then go back quickly, don't be discovered by Ling'er!" Bai Wanru lowered her voice."Okay." Chen Qingyun nodded, got up and left the villa.Instead of going home directly, he bought some fruit and took a taxi to the County People's Hospital to visit Ning Qingmei.In the ward.Ning Qingmei was lying on the bed, reading a book. Her beautiful profile was impeccable, noble and cold, like a fairy from the Moon Palace, and could not be compared to the vulgar beauty.For a moment, Chen Qingyun was stunned, and the fruits in her hands fell to the ground, which caught her attention."Why are you here?" Ning Qingmei was a little surprised to see him, but her beautiful eyes flashed with joy.After all, the two of them just met by chance, without any connection, and Chen Qingyun not only saved her, but also came to visit... "Sister Qingmei, it is my job to guard the reservoir. If something almost happened to you, of course I will be responsible to the end!" Chen Qingyun said sternly.Ning Qingmei showed admiration, nodded and said: "Nowadays, there are fewer and fewer responsible young cadres like you!" "Hey... what kind of cadre am I? I offended someone before and was sent to the reservoir!" Chen Qingyun shook his head helplessly."I think you will make a noble friend soon!" Ning Qingmei said with a smile.Hearing this, Chen Qingyun was a little strange, because Concubine Xiao Yun had said similar things before and even made a bet with him."That's right!" Suddenly, Ning Qingmei seemed to have thought of something, her pretty face turned slightly red, her noble and cold aura disappeared, and she became a little shy instead."You said before that you can treat white tigers. Is it true?" Ning Qingmei asked in a low voice."Of course! This method of grasping the phoenix tendon was handed down from my ancestor, the Chen family. Sister Qingmei, if you don't believe it, you can try it now!" Chen Qingyun said.Chen Qingyun had some expectations in his heart.After all, a beauty like Ning Qingmei is like a flower on the high mountain, and ordinary people are not even qualified to know her.How could he not be happy if he could have close contact with her?Please remember the first domain name of this book: fzhldax.Dingdian Novel Network mobile version reading URL: fzhldax
